name: Grunt Logmar
summary: At Camp Taurajo, Grunt Logmar watches the southern Barrens frontier for the Horde. He tracks threats near the camp and seeks aid for missing scouts.

sections.title: Duty at Camp Taurajo
sections.body: At Camp Taurajo, Grunt Logmar guards the Horde's southern Barrens frontier. The camp lies among the tauren, near hostile quilboar grounds and the mountain passes into Stonetalon and Mulgore. Logmar keeps watch over these dangers and coordinates scouting reports. When his comrades are ambushed or captured by local hostiles, he calls on capable Horde travelers to help find and aid them.

faq.answer: Grunt Logmar is an orc soldier at Camp Taurajo in the southern Barrens. He guards the settlement for the Horde and oversees rescue and scouting efforts.

faq.q: Where can Grunt Logmar be found?
faq.answer: You can find Grunt Logmar at Camp Taurajo, in the southern Barrens along the road toward the Great Lift and Thousand Needles.
Logmar oversees the safety of missing Horde scouts. He sends travelers to investigate the disappearance and captivity of fellow grunt Dogran and recover vital supplies such as Ken'zigla's draught.

angles.text: Logmar is a frontline Horde soldier supporting the tauren in the Barrens. He relies on Horde champions to aid fallen and captured scouts.
As an orc grunt stationed far from Orgrimmar, you stand alongside the Horde's tauren allies.
